ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Technical validation and later stages need Decision process and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Solution fit", 3, "Technical validation", 4, "Proposal", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Contract out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Decision_process__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Decision process and Next step date before moving to Technical validation.
